candidates.exact_claim: For input |psi> on wire A and shared Bell state |Phi+> on B,C, apply CNOT with A as control and B as target, then H on A; in wire order A,B,C the output is 1/2 sum over a,b of |ab>_AB tensor X_C^b Z_C^a |psi>_C.
candidates.why_warranted: The source gives the explicit ordered three-wire preparation, gate order and four outcome-indexed receiver states. A circuit diagram with the outcome labels makes the tensor-factor convention and correction order easy to verify at a glance.
candidates.specific_content: Draw wires A,B,C in that order, with |psi> on A and |Phi+> shared across B,C; put CNOT A->B before H on A (the rightmost gate in V_AB acts first); label the four output branches ab on A,B and X^b Z^a on C. Do not imply measurement is part of V_AB, which is only the encoding unitary.
candidates.evidence_note: The original tile contains the complete vector identity and gate conventions but no diagram. Candidate only; the source fully specifies the operation.

candidates.exact_claim: The four-wire reversible AND example maps |a,b,y,0> to |a,b,y xor ab,0> using Toffoli(a,b;w), then CNOT(w,y), then Toffoli(a,b;w), returning clean work w to zero.
candidates.why_warranted: The item centers on a concrete compute-copy-uncompute circuit and already verifies its action in a full truth table. A small wire diagram would expose the clean-work lifecycle, target-copy step and reverse computation compactly.
candidates.specific_content: Draw input wires a,b, target y and clean work w initialized to 0; apply Toffoli controls a,b targeting w, CNOT w->y, and the same Toffoli again to uncompute w. Label the map |a,b,y,0> -> |a,b,y xor ab,0>; preserve chronological order and show w returns to 0.
candidates.evidence_note: The original tiles contain the exact gate sequence and complete basis truth table but no circuit diagram. Candidate only; no content defect.
